Actor Govinda to debut on reality TV show 'Rise and Fall Season 2'

Actor Govinda is set to make his reality television debut with the upcoming season of the show 'Rise and Fall'. This marks his entry into the reality genre. The show is titled 'Rise and Fall Season 2'. Details about his specific role or involvement in the show have not been fully disclosed, but his participation is confirmed. The coverage also mentions Arjun Bijlani as a winner from a previous season of 'Rise and Fall'. The context of his marriage row was also noted in relation to his upcoming television appearance.
